proposal.reason: Main change is in runtime launch/enqueue: regular plans now launch with explicit argument-buffer pointer and actual size, and the shared kernel-arg storage budget is raised to 4 KiB. Include kernels because collective kernel entry signatures/types are updated from 1 KiB to 4 KiB argument storage. Include symmetric because its scheduler adds an explicit 1 KiB grouping budget cap to preserve symmetric multi-task packing behavior despite the larger regular-plan budget.
